newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Westpac says buyback costs A$222.87 mln.
newsitem.headline: Westpac says buyback costs A$222.87 mln.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corp said on Friday that it acquired 31.103 million of its ordinary shares at a total cost of A$222.87 million under its buyback programme for up to 85 million shares announced in November last year.

The big four bank said the repurchase represented 1.72 percent of its ordinary stock, with a highest price paid of A$7.40 per share on February 6 and the lowest price of A$6.97 paid on December 13 last year. Westpac shares were 10 cents lower at A$7.22 at 12.00 p.m. (0200 GMT).
Westpac's latest buyback offer of up to 50 million shares begins next Monday. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
